create_challenge_instance: create a Challenge instance that reads the CHALLENGE_CONFIG_FILE environment variable for evaluation config
submit_agent_evaluation: submit an agent to the Challenge for evaluation and log all resulting metrics
run_remote_evaluation: run a Challenge with eval_remote set to true to submit results to the remote server
review_challenge_class: review the Challenge class that extends Benchmark to evaluate agents and log metrics
summarize_challenge_submit: summarize the Challenge submit method which evaluates an agent and logs each metric key-value pair
